subject: POC prompt set & eval plan - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: POC prompt set & eval plan - next steps

Hi Alex - great conversation this morning, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before the POC kickoff:

Scope / Success criteria (as discussed):
- In-scope: user-facing summarization + clinical Q&A prompts derived from your triage chat logs.
- Quality bar: >= 90% pass rate on the rubric for summarization tasks (as defined in the template).
- Performance bar: 95th percentile latency < 200 ms for standard 512-token requests on the Dedicated config.
- Safety: no PHI leakage outside customer environment; logs retained per your retention policy.

What we need from Acme to get the eval started:
1) Prompt set CSV with columns: prompt_id, prompt_text, expected_output_category, scoring_guidelines (short), examples.
2) Sample chat logs (anonymized) for KV/prefix caching simulation - a single ZIP is fine.
3) Any domain-specific scoring rules you want us to apply (e.g., must_preserve_diagnosis_terms).

Deliverables / Ownership:
- Marissa (me): Program lead and primary customer contact - I’ll sync timelines and unblock procurement.
- Rishi (cc): evaluation plan & harness owner - will run model comparisons and report results.
- Vivek (cc): infra/tuning advisor - will propose batching/quantization settings if needed.

Timeline (proposed):
- Please share prompts + sample logs by EOD Friday 2026-04-03 so we can instrument the eval.
- Rishi to run initial baseline eval and share results by 2026-04-10.
- 30-min sync to review results week of 2026-04-13 (suggest Tue/Wed).

I’ve attached a small CSV template (poc-eval-template.csv) to make the prompt formatting quick. If you prefer a different schema, send over and we’ll adapt.

Thanks - excited to get started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
https://redwood.com

Attachment: poc-eval-template.csv (CSV template for prompt set)

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC prompt set & eval plan - next steps

Thanks Marissa - appreciate the clear summary. We’ll get you the prompt set and logs. Quick answers inline:

- We can meet the proposed success criteria (90% on summarization rubric) for the initial POC.
- Performance target acknowledged - we’ll prioritize requests that match your 512-token guidance.

Deliverables we’ll attach:
- acme_prompts_v1.csv (prompt_id, prompt_text, expected_output_category, sample_expected_text)
- chat_logs_20260329.zip (anonymized chat exports; includes session metadata)

We also have a short internal scoring guideline doc - attaching that to help with rubric mapping. If you need additional columns (e.g., severity_level) let us know and we’ll add them.

Procurement note: Jordan is leading procurement on our side and will follow up on any paperwork.

Alex
Alex Chen
Head of Product, Acme Health
alex.chen@acmehealth.com

Attachment: acme_prompts_v1.csv, chat_logs_20260329.zip

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Mar 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC prompt set & eval plan - next steps

Looping in a few technical notes based on the prompt/log deliverables Alex mentioned.

High-level eval approach:
- Run three baseline model variants: redwood-small, redwood-medium, redwood-optimized-quant.
- Metrics: task-level accuracy (per rubric), ROUGE-L for summarization, and latency P95.
- Use the provided chat logs to emulate session state for KV cache and prefix hits - that will give realistic latency numbers.

Rishi - can you: 
- Import acme_prompts_v1.csv into the eval harness, map their scoring_guidelines to our rubric, and run the baseline suite by 2026-04-10.
- Include a small A/B on batching levels (batch sizes: 1, 4, 8) to show latency/cost tradeoffs.

Marissa - I’ll prepare recommended quantization/batching configurations once we see the prompt distribution. FYI I’ll need access to their sample logs in S3 or via secure upload; if they prefer we can accept via the shared ZIP attached in Alex’s reply.

Vivek
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

Alex / Jordan - thanks for sending the files. Confirmed receipt of acme_prompts_v1.csv and chat_logs_20260329.zip. I’ve uploaded the ZIP to our secure intake and shared the ingestion link with Rishi and Vivek.

Next steps:
- Rishi to run initial import + baseline eval (by 2026-04-10).
- Vivek to propose quantization/batching settings after the first pass.
- Marissa to schedule a 30-min results review: I’ve proposed 2026-04-06 11:00 AM PT - please accept or suggest an alternative: https://redwood.app/sync/meet/2026-04-06-30m

Procurement / legal: Jordan - we’ve shared a one-page MSA/POC addendum for signature via DocuSign. Link: https://docusign.com/ACME-POC-12345. If you want the finance team looped, cc procurement@acmehealth.com and I’ll get the contract owner involved.

We’ll treat the initial run as a research/evaluation activity - if the results look good we’ll propose a Dedicated sizing and longer-term rollout.

Thanks again - looking forward to the results.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
